Q-01.reason: Export has no navigator tree; Export setup is a bounded property pane.

Q-02.reason: Mapping details are not a result list; their overflow is evaluated in Q-09.

Q-03.reason: Materials navigation is not mounted in Modeling Export.

Q-04.reason: Fit controls and candidate drawer are upstream; Export keeps only selected Fit source context.

Q-05.reason: The bounded Fit source graph labels True stress (MPa) against true plastic strain [1] with positive initial yield.

Q-06.reason: Family legend remains compact and inside the bounded graph.

Q-07.reason: SVG preserveAspectRatio is uniform across responsive captures.

Q-08.reason: Metal source response starts at positive yield stress at zero true plastic strain.

Q-09.reason: Normal mapping is compact; long overflow is covered by long-mapping evidence.

Q-10.reason: Legend is placed in a curve-free graph quadrant.

Q-11.reason: Export has no Fit rail; the right context is a bounded result column.

Q-12.reason: Export setup identifies the exact saved branch by selected model only; Output unit system remains a capability-backed selector with unsupported alternatives disabled, ambiguous r1 shorthand is absent, and physical values appear once in Mapping details.

Q-13.reason: Setup and mapping rows use one compact title/value/status rhythm; explanatory prose and technical counts are disclosed only on demand.

Q-14.reason: Readiness and the exact next action are stated once in Export check; preview and mapping regions avoid duplicate alert prose.

Q-15.reason: The family plot uses data-span-proportional headroom, uniform SVG geometry, correct family quantities and a curve-free legend.

Q-16.reason: The native preview remains dominant; bounded result context has no normal fake rail and genuine long content exposes independent local scrolling.
